is_erc4626_flag_analysis.what_matched: The static.json is_erc4626=true was set by ERC-4626 signatures (convertToShares/convertToAssets/totalAssets/previewDeposit/IERC4626) found ONLY in lib/forge-std test-dependency interfaces (lib/forge-std/src/interfaces/IERC4626.sol and IERC7575.sol). No in-scope protocol contract implements or imports ERC-4626. Beanstalk has no literal tokenized vault.
is_erc4626_flag_analysis.share_accounting_analogue: Beanstalk's silo uses a share-like accounting model: roots ~ shares, stalk ~ assets/governance-weight, earnedBeans ~ distributable yield. Roots are minted/burned via LibSilo.mintActiveStalk / burnActiveStalk and consumed by LibSilo._balanceOfEarnedBeans (earned-Bean distribution) and LibFlood (sop plenty). This is the correct surface to assess the analogous ERC-4626 risks, and it was assessed below.

analogous_risk_assessment.first_depositor_empty_state_minting: SAFE. When s.sys.silo.roots == 0 the bootstrap mint uses a fixed roots = stalk * C.ROOTS_BASE (1e12), a constant baseline multiplier independent of any attacker donation (LibSilo.mintActiveStalk:183-184, LibGerminate.endTotalGermination:100-101). This behaves like a virtual-offset baseline; there is no 1-wei-deposit-then-donate inflation vector.
analogous_risk_assessment.donation_airdrop_skew: NOT APPLICABLE. The 'asset' totals (s.sys.silo.stalk, s.sys.silo.roots) and the yield pool (s.sys.silo.earnedBeans) are internal accounting variables. They are never derived from token.balanceOf(address(this)) (grep confirmed: no balanceOf(address(this)) in libraries/Silo or beanstalk/silo). A direct Bean/token transfer to the diamond does not change any share-price input, so the ERC-4626 donation attack cannot move the root-to-stalk ratio.
analogous_risk_assessment.just_in_time_deposit_yield_capture: MITIGATED by germination. New deposits' stalk and roots germinate for 2 full seasons via LibGerminate.endTotalGermination before being added to the active s.sys.silo.stalk / s.sys.silo.roots totals and before they can earn Beans. This defeats the deposit-immediately-before-yield / withdraw-after pattern.
analogous_risk_assessment.rounding_direction: PROTOCOL-CONSERVATIVE. Root minting rounds DOWN (LibSilo.mintActiveStalk:188, burnActiveStalk:244). _balanceOfEarnedBeans rounds down and clamps negative results to 0 (LibSilo:689-695) and clamps to s.sys.silo.earnedBeans. transferStalk deliberately rounds UP against the sender (s.sys.silo.roots.sub(1).mul(stalk).div(s.sys.silo.stalk).add(1), LibSilo:298) so the sender always burns at least the fair number of roots. All rounding favors the protocol.

is_erc4626_flag_analysis.scope_note: The genuine accounting defects in this codebase (ReseedSilo '=' vs '+=' stalk overwrite, L2ContractMigrationFacet.addMigratedDepositsToAccount zeroing global per-token totals, replay-based stalk/roots minting in redeemDepositsAndInternalBalances) are migration/reseed logic, arithmetic, and access-control bugs. They corrupt share-accounting state but are not ERC-4626 vault-pattern vulnerabilities (no inflation/rounding-direction/totalAssets-manipulation primitive); they are owned by the logic, arithmetic, and access_control specialists per attack_surface.agent_hints and are intentionally NOT duplicated here.
